Package index

Package

Package overview, the five-step pipeline, and where to start.

catchmentACS catchmentACS-package
catchmentACS: Isochrone-Based Area-Weighted ACS Aggregation

Core pipeline

Generate isochrones, fetch or reuse ACS data, intersect catchments, propagate MOEs, and derive rates.

cacs_run()
Run the catchmentACS orchestrator
cacs_isochrone()
Compute drive-time isochrones via provider dispatch
cacs_acs_prefetch()
Fetch single-state ACS tract data with caching and resilient retries
cacs_intersect_weight()
Aggregate ACS tract estimates to isochrone catchments by area weight
cacs_propagate_moe()
Propagate margins of error across catchment ACS estimates
cacs_derive_rates()
Derive curated catchment ACS rates from a propagated-MOE tibble

Result summaries and descriptions

Inspect pipeline outputs and convert results for tables or downstream dplyr workflows.

cacs_describe() print(<cacs_description>)
Describe catchmentACS provenance attached to an object
cacs_summary_as_markdown()
Render a catchmentACS summary table as pipe Markdown
summary(<cacs_run_result>)
Summarise a catchmentACS run result
print(<cacs_run_result>)
Print a catchmentACS run result
print(<cacs_run_summary>)
Print a catchmentACS run summary
as_tibble.cacs_run_result()
Convert a catchmentACS run result to a plain tibble (rate-first by default)
group_by.cacs_run_result()
Group a catchmentACS run result as a plain tibble

Visual walkthrough helpers

Build site-level leaflet views for isochrones, intersections, weighted ACS variables, and rates.

cacs_plot_site_pipeline()
Build the full four-stage site walkthrough at once
cacs_plot_site_isochrone()
Map a site and its isochrone (walkthrough stage 1)
cacs_plot_site_intersection()
Map isochrone overlap with census tracts (walkthrough stage 2)
cacs_plot_site_weighted()
Map a census variable across overlapping tracts (walkthrough stage 3)
cacs_plot_site_rates()
Map a site's headline rate estimates (walkthrough stage 4)
format(<cacs_site_plot_pipeline>)
Format a site plot pipeline as a one-line string
print(<cacs_site_plot_pipeline>)
Print a site plot pipeline

Cache and configuration

Configure and inspect package cache behavior.

cacs_cache_dir()
Get (or create) the catchmentACS cache directory
cacs_set_cache()
Enable or disable the catchmentACS cache
cacs_get_cache_state()
Inspect cache configuration and session counters
cacs_clear_cache()
Clear cached catchmentACS artifacts
cacs_cache_status()
Summarize cached catchmentACS artifacts on disk

Validation and conditions

Validate ACS/isochrone inputs and capture structured package conditions.

cacs_acs_validate()
Validate a user-supplied ACS tract table
cacs_validate_iso()
Preflight-check an isochrone object against the catchmentACS schema
cacs_validate_osrm_endpoint()
Pre-flight check of an OSRM endpoint's current quota state
cacs_capture_conditions()
Capture catchmentACS conditions from an expression
catchmentACS-conditions catchmentACS_condition catchmentACS_message catchmentACS_warning catchmentACS_error
catchmentACS condition classes

Rates, MOE helpers, and cumulative rings

Reusable helpers for rate definitions, MOE conversion, and cumulative travel-time rings.

cacs_acs_default_rates
Default catalogue of curated catchment ACS rates
cacs_rings_to_cumulative()
Convert annulus-topology isochrone rings to cumulative-topology rings
cacs_se_to_moe()
Convert a standard error to a margin of error
cacs_moe_to_se()
Convert a margin of error to a standard error

Bundled data

Small package data objects and fixtures used in examples and tests.

cacs_acs_default_vars
Default ACS source variables for cacs_acs_prefetch()
cacs_alabama_sites
Synthetic Alabama Pre-K sample sites
